content: प्रदेशः .²1 Pointing out, indicating. .²2 A place, region, spot, country, territory, district; पितुः प्रदेशास्तव देवभूमयः <ls>Ku. 5. 45</ls>; <ls>R. 5. 60</ls>; so कण्ठ˚, तालु˚, हृदय˚, <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 A span measured from the tip of the thumb to that of the fore-finger. .²4 Decision, determination. .²5 A wall. .²6 An example (in <ab>gram.</ab>). .²7 (With Jainas) One of the obstacles to liberation. --{%a.%} Commanding (ईशनशील); एते प्रदेशाः कथिता भुवनानां प्रभावनाः <ls>Mb. 12. 208. 10</ls>. (<ab>com.</ab> प्रदेशाः प्रदिशन्ति आज्ञापयन्तीति).
